terms.metaDescription: The terms that govern your use of the SupoClip apps and hosted video-clipping service, including subscriptions purchased on the web or through the App Store.
terms.ogDescription: The terms that govern your use of SupoClip.
terms.title: Terms of Service

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.p1: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your use of the SupoClip apps and hosted service (the “Service”), which turn long-form videos into short, captioned clips. By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
agreement.p2: SupoClip is also available as open-source software you can self-host. These Terms apply to the SupoClip-operated hosted service; self-hosted instances are governed by the applicable open-source license and the operator’s own terms.

account.title: Your Account
account.p1: You must provide accurate information when creating an account and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity that occurs under your account. You must be at least 13 years old (or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction) to use the Service.

content.title: Your Content & Responsibilities
content.p1: You retain ownership of the videos you submit and the clips the Service generates from them. You grant us the limited rights needed to process, store, and deliver that content to you as part of operating the Service.
content.p2: You are solely responsible for having the necessary rights to any content you submit, including videos referenced by URL. You may not use the Service to process content that infringes the rights of others, is unlawful, or violates a platform’s terms that bind you.

billing.title: Subscriptions & Billing
billing.p1: Paid plans (for example Pro and Creator) include a monthly allowance of source-video minutes and a maximum output resolution. Each video uses its full length, rounded up to the minute, when processing starts; jobs that fail without producing clips don't count. Allowances reset monthly, including on yearly plans, and unused minutes don't carry over. The same plan entitlement applies to your account regardless of where you purchased it.
billing.web: Web subscriptions are billed by our payment processor, Stripe, on a monthly basis. They renew automatically until canceled. You can cancel anytime via the billing portal in Settings; access continues until the end of the paid period.
billing.ios: Subscriptions purchased in the iOS app are billed to your Apple ID as auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment is charged at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel App Store subscriptions in your device’s subscription settings; they cannot be managed from the web. Refunds for App Store purchases are handled by Apple.
billing.p2: A subscription is managed by the platform where it was purchased. Prices may change with notice; changes apply at the next renewal. Except where required by law or by the platform’s refund policy, fees are non-refundable.

acceptable.title: Acceptable Use
acceptable.li1: No infringing, unlawful, or harmful content.
acceptable.li2: No attempts to probe, disrupt, or overload the Service or circumvent usage limits.
acceptable.li3: No reselling or white-labeling the hosted Service without our written permission.
acceptable.li4: No use of the Service to violate third-party platform terms that apply to you.
acceptable.closing: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.p1: The Service, including its software, design, and branding, is owned by SupoClip or its licensors. The open-source components are licensed under their respective licenses. These Terms do not grant you any rights to our trademarks.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
disclaimers.p1: The Service is provided “as is” and “as available.” AI-generated output (transcripts, captions, clip selections, virality estimates) may contain errors and is provided without warranty of accuracy. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim all warranties, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.p1: To the fullest extent permitted by law, SupoClip will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for lost profits, data, or goodwill. Our aggregate liability for claims relating to the Service is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim arose.

termination.title: Termination
termination.p1: You may stop using the Service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate your access for violation of these Terms or where required by law. Sections that by their nature should survive termination (such as ownership, disclaimers, and limitation of liability) survive.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
changes.p1: We may update these Terms from time to time. When we do, we will revise the “Last updated” date above and, where appropriate, provide additional notice. Your continued use of the Service after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: Questions about these Terms? Email us at <email>support@supoclip.com</email>.

privacy.metaDescription: How SupoClip collects, uses, shares, and protects your data when you use the SupoClip video-clipping service.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: This Privacy Policy explains how SupoClip (“SupoClip,” “we,” “us”) collects, uses, shares, and protects information when you use the SupoClip apps and hosted service (the “Service”), which turn long-form videos into short, captioned clips.
overview.p2: SupoClip is also available as open-source software you can self-host. If you use a self-hosted instance operated by you or a third party, that operator—not SupoClip—is responsible for the data processed by that instance. This policy describes the SupoClip-operated hosted service.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.account: When you create an account we collect your name, email address, and a securely hashed password. Authentication is handled by our auth provider; we do not store plaintext passwords.
collect.content: To generate clips, we process the video URLs you submit (for example links to videos you are authorized to use) and any video files you upload. We store the resulting clips, transcripts, captions, and related processing metadata so you can view, edit, and export them. You are responsible for having the rights to any content you submit.
collect.billing: Paid plans are processed by our payment processor, Stripe. We do not store your full card number; we retain your subscription status and a customer identifier needed to manage billing.
collect.usage: We collect session identifiers, IP address, and basic technical logs to operate, secure, and debug the Service. If analytics are enabled for the hosted site, we use a privacy-friendly analytics provider that does not build cross-site advertising profiles. We also use PostHog on the hosted site to understand how the product is used, to replay sessions (with everything typed into form fields masked), and to receive error reports so we can fix problems.
collect.campaign1: When you visit our website while signed out, your browser keeps a record of how you first arrived, for up to 90 days. It stores this in your browser's local storage, not in a cookie. The record includes campaign tags in the link you followed (such as <utmSource>utm_source</utmSource>, <utmCampaign>utm_campaign</utmCampaign>, or a <ref>ref</ref> code), the domain of the referring website (not the full address), the page you landed on, and the time of that visit. Page addresses are reduced to their route, so share links and project IDs are never recorded. Nothing is recorded while you are signed in.
collect.campaign2: The first account to sign in on that browser claims the record, and it is then deleted from the browser so no other account can use it. If that account is new, we save the record to it once, shortly after sign-up. We also note when you first download or export a clip. We use this to learn which channels bring people who find SupoClip useful. If analytics are enabled, the sign-up and clip-export events we send to our analytics provider include the same campaign fields. We don't use this information for advertising or sell it. You can remove the record from your browser by clearing site data for supoclip.com.

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.li1: Provide the Service—process your videos and generate, edit, and export clips.
use.li2: Authenticate you and keep your account secure.
use.li4: Send transactional email (for example sign-up confirmation, completion notices, and billing receipts).
use.li5: Maintain, debug, secure, and improve the Service.
use.li6: Understand which campaigns and referring sites lead to sign-ups and first clip exports.
use.li7: If you connect a social account, publish the clips you choose and show you how they perform.
use.li8: Comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms.

social.title: Connected Social Accounts
social.p1: You can connect a YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram account so SupoClip can publish clips for you. Connecting is optional, happens through the platform's own sign-in page, and we never see your password for that platform.
social.li1: <label>Basic profile</label> (account ID, display name, username, profile picture) — to show which account is connected.
social.li2: <label>Permission to upload or publish</label> — to post the clips you choose, with the title, caption, visibility, and time you set. We never post anything you didn't ask us to.
social.li3: <label>Statistics for posts made through SupoClip</label> (views, likes, comments, shares) — to show you how your clips perform and, once you have enough results, to tailor clip selection for your own future videos.
social.tokens: We store the access tokens the platform issues in encrypted form and use them only for the purposes above. We do not sell this data, use it for advertising, share it with other users, or use it to train general-purpose AI models.
social.disconnect: You can disconnect an account at any time from the Social page. Disconnecting deletes the stored tokens immediately, cancels any posts still scheduled for that account, and asks the platform to revoke SupoClip's access where it supports that. You can also remove records of published posts, including their statistics, from the app. Deleting your SupoClip account removes all of this data. You can also revoke access from the platform itself, for Google at <google>Google security settings</google>. To ask us to delete this data, email <email>privacy@supoclip.com</email>.
social.youtube: SupoClip uses YouTube API Services. By connecting a YouTube account you agree to the <youtubeTerms>YouTube Terms of Service</youtubeTerms>, and Google's handling of your data is described in the <googlePrivacy>Google Privacy Policy</googlePrivacy>. SupoClip's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the <googleApi>Google API Services User Data Policy</googleApi>, including the Limited Use requirements.

processors.title: Service Providers & Subprocessors
processors.intro: We share data with vendors that process it on our behalf, only as needed to provide the Service:
processors.li1: <label>Transcription</label> — to transcribe audio from your videos.
processors.li2: <label>AI/LLM providers</label> — to analyze transcripts and identify clip-worthy segments.
processors.li6: <label>Analytics</label> — when enabled, to measure site visits, sign-ups, and clip exports.
processors.li7: <label>YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram (Meta)</label> — only if you connect an account, to publish the clips you choose and read their statistics (see Connected Social Accounts).
processors.li8: <label>PostHog</label> — on the hosted site, product analytics, session replays with form inputs masked, and error reports. Hosted in the EU.
processors.closing: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights, safety, and security of our users and the Service.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.p1: We retain your account information, including any campaign and referral information saved at sign-up, for as long as your account is active. Your tasks, uploaded videos, and generated clips are retained until you delete them or delete your account. Temporary processing files are deleted automatically after processing. We may retain limited records as required for legal, security, or accounting purposes.

rights.title: Your Rights & Choices
rights.p1: You can access and update your account information in the app. You can delete individual tasks and clips at any time. You can delete your account—which removes your associated data—from the app, or by contacting us at <email>privacy@supoclip.com</email>.
rights.p2: Depending on where you live (for example under GDPR or CCPA/CPRA), you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or port your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise these rights, contact us at the address below. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

security.title: Security
security.p1: We use industry-standard safeguards, including encryption in transit (HTTPS). On mobile devices, session credentials are stored in the operating system keychain. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your information using reasonable technical and organizational measures.

transfers.title: International Transfers
transfers.p1: We may process and store information in countries other than where you live. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for such transfers.

children.title: Children’s Privacy
children.p1: The Service is not directed to children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the “Last updated” date above and, where appropriate, provide additional notice. Your continued use of the Service after an update means you accept the revised policy.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: Questions about this policy or your data? Email us at <email>privacy@supoclip.com</email>.
